lessons: The review found missing tests. Add route() tests for three cases: retry that hits the same gate code climbs a rung; retry that clears the code returns Routing(None, None) with no marker; spent cap plus escalate returns the MARKER with the spent-cap reason.

Add a test_terminal case: seed a retry draw at rung {tier: high, effort: max}, then run with escalate. Assert the terminal has routed reject_queue, a reject_reason naming the exhausted ladder, and the reject_queue_arrival signal.
Add a drain test where escalating to the top of the ladder puts the stem under 'reject queue:' and it is not re-offered.

Do not copy caps.consume into drain.py. consume(journal, repo, git, stem, cap, run_seq) has no rung parameter, and caps.py is outside the fence. The ticket's Definition of rejected makes this premise_failed: answer premise_failed rather than forking the writer.

Do not catch RoutingError in reject.route and fall back to Routing(None, None); that fails open. Give the scripted drain/terminal tests a routing config instead of bending production code to fit them.

The terminal reason that identical() compares must come from codes only (outcome, stage, sorted finding codes), never from delivery.reason free text. Add a test: same codes with different detail text count as identical.
reason: Every review snag is fixable: missing acceptance tests, a fail-open catch, and a free-text comparison key. The one blocker, consume() having no rung field, has a stated premise_failed road, so no more capability is needed.
